batch: P6 tail: audit indexes 1272–1638 including 59 actionable supplied URLs and 7 invalid literal 'Not found' values
notes: Most sources were public infrastructure/retail/park locator pages, not gay male party organisers. The public cruising-area entries remain in the research database.
OX's 7 January entries were independently confirmed by its official calendar but already appear in events.json.
Seven Website_URL values literally say 'Not found'; they were moved to no-website/other-source queue, not counted as website checks.
Earlier pending URLs must still be reviewed; next_index reached end but backfill_next_index points to earliest remaining pending.
